Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method of cementing comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin derived from an inulin processed from chicory; and allowing the cement composition to set.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed under wellbore conditions.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein a suspension aid is not intentionally added to the cement composition.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 600 or higher.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin having a degree of substitution of from about 0.2 to about 0.3.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.5 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition further comprises borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or any combination thereof specifically excluding conventional hydrocarboxylic acid-based retarders.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore specifically in a subterranean formation.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): A method of cementing in a subterranean formation comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin derived from an inulin processed from chicory; placing the cement composition in the subterranean formation; and allowing the cement composition to set therein.
